versions.dem: LDEM_80S_20MPP_ADJ.TIF (PGDA 90, 2023-07-07), block mean of 5 x 5 pixels of 20 m

purpose: 3D view only (display); numbers come from the horizon masks in sites.json
corner: x_min/y_max are the outer edges of pixel (0,0); pixel centres sit half a pixel inside; the site is within 50 m of the tile centre on each axis, up to 71 m diagonally (tile edges on the 100 m grid of the DEM); place it with site_x, site_y
layout: Float32 little-endian, row-major, row 0 = north edge (+y), NaN = no data
axes: +x toward 90 E, +y toward 0 E; lon = atan2(x, y)
dem_max_note: max of the full-resolution 80 m DEM (not this tile)
